collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE IV: ROMANCE, COURTSHIP AND WEDDINGS (LCD-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Crushes and courting on Isola: wondering whether someone likes you back, flowers and love songs, first dates, serenades gone wrong, proposals, weddings big and small, how many children, breakups and starting over.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A villager must tell their partner they broke the canoe the couple built together: tell them now, or fix it first.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) and (friend) spent a whole season building a canoe together. Today (subject) took it out alone, hit a rock, and put a hole in the bow the size of a fist. (friend) does not know yet. (subject) feels sick. What should (subject.he/she) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) tells (friend) straight away. (friend) goes very quiet, then very loud, then very quiet again. Then (friend.he/she) goes down to the beach to look at the hole. "We can fix that," (friend.he/she) says at last. They fix it together. It takes a week and they argue the whole time.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) spends two nights patching the hole in secret. Then (subject.he/she) tells (friend) anyway. (friend) is more upset about the secret than the hole. It takes a while. But (friend.he/she) admits the patch is very good.
